items.titulo: Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang
items.resumen: Tsinghua researchers released AKV, an SGLang-based serving system for cache engineering. LLM agents drop and reposition KV cache instead of summarizing history, cutting average cost 27.7% across 4 agent benchmarks. The post Tsinghua AI Open-Sources AKV, a Cache Engineering Server for LLM Agents on SGLang appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: AI delivers ‘zero financial payoff’ to most companies, Apollo economist says
items.resumen: "Despite massive investments and widespread hype around artificial intelligence, the technology has delivered zero financial payoff to corporate America outside of tech."

items.titulo: Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model
items.resumen: Nanbeige LLM Lab released Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B dense Apache 2.0 model with 512K context. It reports 80.9 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and will teach the upcoming Nanbeige4.3-3B. The post Nanbeige Releases Nanbeige4.3-33B, a 33B Open Agentic Coding Model appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time
items.resumen: Hugging Face released Carbon-X, an open 14.8B DNA language model built on Qwen3-14B. It reads raw DNA in chat, answers in English, and averages 66.7% across 5 DNA benchmarks under Apache 2.0. The post Hugging Face Releases Carbon-X, a 14B Open DNA Language Model that Brings DNA and Natural Language Together for the First Time appeared first on MarkTechPost .
